app: MITIGATION: converting silent divergences to explicit (answers Windows FL Studio/OBS/rekordbox)
channel_setup: src/coverage-guard.mjs: (A) per-region pixel spot-check via content-energy (sharp), (B) view self-consistency. Fed NATIVE-STYLE structure (labeled panes, no content children) mimicking UIA/Qt on FL Studio/OBS; verified on pages/silent-mimicry.html.

t1_read_text.detail: The guard does NOT read hidden content — it makes the blind spot DECLARED. Guard A: 'Recent projects' pane painting 4 .flp rows -> energy 0.072 -> flagged [pixels] group ... [unverified: pixels show content]; 'Preview' pane painting 'On arrive bientôt' -> 0.063 -> flagged; genuinely-empty labeled dock -> 0.000 -> NOT flagged (no false positive). Guard B: a 'columnheaders + "32 Tracks" + 0 rows' view (the rekordbox shape) flagged inconsistent from the view alone, no pixels. Together they convert all three Windows silent shapes to explicit.

t2_enumerate.detail: Region-level: suspect = any structure-empty rect; router pairs it with a per-region pixel crop (Windows: PrintWindow PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT; browser/AX/AT-SPI: clip). Threshold 0.03 ink-ratio separated painted (0.06-0.07) from empty (0.00) cleanly here.

t6_pictorial.detail: This IS the pictorial-blind-spot guarantee generalized to native named-but-empty containers, where the toolkit gives no canvas/img element to declare. The declaration now comes from a pixel spot-check, not from the element type.

measurements.notes: THE paper-critical mitigation. Cost model: the guard only crops regions structure flags empty (rare), so it adds pixels sub-linearly, not a full screenshot. Turns the campaign message from 'we found 3 silent cells' into 'found AND neutralized by a documented, cross-OS router guard' — the difference between 'not safe' and 'safe with this guard'. Two guards, independent: pixel spot-check (needs a per-region crop) + self-consistency (view-only, free).

runtime_verification.method: content-energy vs known painted/empty regions; self-consistency vs known count/rows
runtime_verification.agreement: 3/3 silent shapes flagged, 1/1 empty control not flagged, 1/1 inconsistency caught
